name: Second Directional Derivative for Boundary Disambiguation
definition: A method to disambiguate complex material boundaries (e.g., background-dentin vs. pulp-dentin) that overlap in 2D data-value/gradient-magnitude histograms by using a second derivative measure along the gradient direction.
summary: Second Directional Derivative for Boundary Disambiguation computes a second derivative measure along the gradient to resolve overlapping material boundaries in 2D histograms, differing from related methods by providing the underlying mathematical mechanism rather than visualization.
